phases.name: Year 1
phases.subtitle: Explore
phases.description: Engineering & Science Foundations — Build STEM literacy, explore civil engineering careers, and develop analytical skills.

milestones.label: Explore civil engineering career pathways
milestones.description: Introduction to engineering disciplines with emphasis on civil engineering applications in transportation, water resources, geotechnical, structural, and environmental engineering.

milestones.label: Build calculus foundations for engineering
milestones.description: Functions, limits, derivatives, and introduction to integration. Mathematical foundation for structural analysis, fluid mechanics, and transportation engineering.

milestones.label: Master engineering graphics and CAD
milestones.description: Engineering drawing standards, Civil 3D, and AutoCAD for civil engineering applications. Students create site plans, road profiles, and utility drawings.

milestones.label: Join ASCE student chapter
milestones.description: Join the American Society of Civil Engineers (ASCE) student chapter, NSBE, or SWE. Participate in concrete canoe, steel bridge, or surveying competitions.

milestones.label: Study physics foundations for engineering
milestones.description: Mechanics, thermodynamics, and waves. Foundation for structural mechanics, fluid dynamics, and geotechnical engineering.

phases.name: Year 2
phases.subtitle: Engage
phases.description: Core Civil Engineering Sciences — Master structural mechanics, fluid mechanics, and surveying.

milestones.label: Master statics and mechanics of materials
milestones.description: Force equilibrium, free body diagrams, trusses, frames, and centroids. Foundation for structural analysis and design of civil infrastructure.

milestones.label: Master surveying and geomatics
milestones.description: Land surveying methods, GPS/GNSS, total stations, leveling, and GIS applications. Students complete field surveying exercises on campus and community sites.

milestones.label: Compete in ASCE concrete canoe or steel bridge competition
milestones.description: Participate in ASCE regional competitions designing and building a concrete canoe or steel bridge. Develop teamwork, project management, and applied structural engineering skills.

milestones.label: Study fluid mechanics and hydraulics
milestones.description: Fluid statics, pipe flow, open channel flow, and hydraulic design. Students analyze water distribution systems and stormwater management infrastructure.

milestones.label: Master mechanics of materials for structures
milestones.description: Stress, strain, beam deflection, column buckling, and combined loading. Students analyze structural elements used in bridges, buildings, and infrastructure.

phases.name: Year 3
phases.subtitle: Develop
phases.description: Advanced Civil Engineering & Professional Experience — Master structural design, geotechnical engineering, and complete internship.

milestones.label: Master structural analysis and design
milestones.description: Analysis of determinate and indeterminate structures using classical and matrix methods. Students design steel and concrete structural elements using AISC and ACI codes.

milestones.label: Study geotechnical engineering
milestones.description: Soil mechanics, foundation design, earth retaining structures, and slope stability analysis. Students conduct laboratory soil testing and analyze geotechnical investigation reports.

milestones.label: Present research or project at ASCE conference
milestones.description: Present undergraduate research or design project at an ASCE regional or national conference. Network with practicing engineers, graduate students, and faculty from other programs.

milestones.label: Complete summer civil engineering internship
milestones.description: Secure and complete an internship at a civil engineering firm, DOT, or construction company. Apply structural, transportation, or geotechnical skills in professional practice.

milestones.label: Study transportation engineering and planning
milestones.description: Highway design, traffic engineering, transportation planning, and pavement design. Students analyze traffic data and design roadway improvements for local transportation projects.

phases.name: Year 4
phases.subtitle: Launch
phases.description: Capstone Design & Career Launch — Complete senior design project, prepare for FE exam, and launch civil engineering career.

milestones.label: Execute senior design capstone project
milestones.description: Complete a year-long civil engineering design project including site design, structural analysis, water/sewer infrastructure, transportation access, and environmental considerations.

milestones.label: Prepare for FE exam and professional licensure
milestones.description: Prepare for the NCEES FE Civil exam through review courses and practice exams. Begin the path toward PE licensure.

milestones.label: Serve as peer mentor and ASCE chapter leader
milestones.description: Mentor underclassmen in civil engineering, lead ASCE chapter activities, and organize site visits, career panels, and competition teams.

milestones.label: Develop career placement portfolio
milestones.description: Assemble a career launch package including technical resume, design portfolio, CAD/BIM samples, FE exam status, and documented professional network.

milestones.label: Complete exit assessment and career activation
milestones.description: Complete the CoE Civil Engineering Exit Assessment demonstrating ABET outcomes. Finalize career activation documenting job offers, graduate admissions, or FE exam results.
